entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A once serene, mana-rich plane broken by the Sundering into five shards and reunited by the Conflux.

entities.name: Sundering
entities.description: The event in which an unknown planeswalker plundered Alara for its mana, breaking it into five shards.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The event that reunited the five shards of Alara into a patchwork plane, accelerated by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A verdant, orderly shard where angels guide mortals.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of high magic and artifice, refined with etherium.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A dying shard where black mana reigns, ruled by demons, necromancers and undead.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A brutal, volcanic shard where red mana dominates and dragons rule.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A vast untamed jungle shard where green mana dominates.

entities.name: Maelstrom
entities.description: A chaotic storm of mana at the point where the five shards met.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Dominarian dragon planeswalker who accelerated the Conflux to restore his power and was stopped by Ajani Goldmane.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who stopped Bolas from destroying all of Alara; later compleated.

entities.name: Asha
entities.description: The archangel who protected Alara and sacrificed herself in battle with Malfegor.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: A demon whose forces Asha protected Alara from and who killed her.

entities.name: Vithia
entities.description: An ancient kingdom that flourished in peace and wisdom, later decayed into Grixis.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian whose Machine Legion targeted Alara.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which Alara was targeted.

entities.name: Rafiq
entities.description: A knight of former Bant among the defenders.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: The traitorous planeswalker who did not interact with Alara's front of the invasion.

events.summary: An unknown planeswalker plunders Alara for its mana, shattering the plane into shards in the Sundering.
events.quote: an unknown Planeswalker plundered Alara for its mana

events.summary: Asha sacrifices herself in battle with the demon Malfegor.
events.quote: Asha, the plane's protector, sacrificed herself in battle with the demon Malfegor .

events.summary: Nicol Bolas foments chaos and destroys the obelisks, accelerating the merging of the shards into the Conflux.
events.quote: he accelerated the process until the shards merged in an event known as the Conflux

events.summary: The shards reunite as a patchwork plane and cultures clash and wars ensue.
events.quote: As the boundaries between the shards dissolved, cultures clashed, and wars ensued.

events.summary: Bolas is stopped from destroying all of Alara by Ajani Goldmane.
events.quote: was ultimately stopped from destroying all of Alara by Ajani Goldmane

events.summary: Travel between the former shards normalizes and a new equilibrium forms.
events.quote: travel between the former shards became normalized, and a new equilibrium was born across the plane

events.summary: Elesh Norn's Machine Legion targets Alara in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Alara was targeted by Elesh Norn 's Machine Legion as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.note: protected the plane from Malfegor and died fighting him
relations.quote: The archangel Asha watched over the plane, protecting its inhabitants from the forces of Malfegor .
